items.title: MGM, People Inc. Switch Places In Merger Talks. People Inc. Soars.
items.summary: People Inc. and MGM Resorts played a round of musical chairs in the midst of their ongoing merger talks.  MGM Resorts is now exploring a bid to buy People Inc., reversing their previous roles, according to The Wall Street Journal.  Meanwhile, MGM Resorts had much more muted gains of about 0.5%.

items.title: People Incorporated Shares Rise 6.5% Following Report of Potential MGM Takeover Bid
items.summary: People Incorporated (NASDAQ:PPLI) shares rose 6. 5% in premarket trading following a Wall Street Journal report that MGM Resorts International (NYSE:MGM) is considering a potential takeover bid for the company.
